context: SHAP-guided remediation paths for M3 non-compliant or low-scoring mixes

add_silica_fume.action_template: Add 10% silica_fume additive (pozzolanic reaction boosts CS by 2-4 MPa)
add_silica_fume.applies_when: CS below 20 MPa with no additive

switch_to_pet.action_template: Switch plastic_type from {current} to PET (higher density 1380 vs {current_density})

extend_curing.action_template: Extend curing_days from {current} to 28 days (65% of 28d strength at 7d)

increase_replacement_for_diversion.action_template: Increase replacement_pct from {current}% to {target}% (diversion increases to {diversion} kg/m3)
